national_news.title: US Proposes Fresh Tariffs of Up to 25% on Imports from India
bullets: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) proposed fresh tariffs ranging from 15% to 35% on imports from 14 major economies, including India, China, and the European Union.
For India, USTR Jamieson Greer proposed duties of up to 25% under existing Section 301 accounting, with a lower 17% rate option if a reciprocal trade agreement is reached.
Public comments on the proposed tariffs are open until January 5, with hearings starting January 25, and measures expected to take effect as early as February.

national_news.title: India Wins Best National Pavilion - Visitors’ Lion Award at Venice Art Biennale
bullets: India won the prestigious 'Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion' award at the Venice Art Biennale, decided through international public voting.
The India Pavilion was hosted at the historic Arsenale and was commissioned by the National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA) under the Ministry of Culture.
The Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) acted as the executing agency for setting up and managing the pavilion.

national_news.title: India Observes Constitution Day on November 26 to Commemorate 1949 Adoption
bullets: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) was observed on 26th November to mark the adoption of the Indian Constitution by the Constituent Assembly in 1949; the day has been officially celebrated since 2015.
The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs organized an online reading of the Preamble via the MyGov portal in 23 languages, comprising the 22 Scheduled Languages and English.
Nationwide activities including Preamble readings, debates, seminars, and awareness walks were organized by Union Ministries and State Governments to foster constitutional awareness.

national_news.title: 20th WAVES Film Bazaar Concludes at IFFI Goa with Bilateral Agreements
bullets: The 20th edition of the WAVES Film Bazaar at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa attracted 2,288 delegates from 54 countries and facilitated around 220 business-to-business (B2B) meetings.
Key outcomes announced by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting include two Letters of Intent for India-Chile co-productions and finalization stages for 14 Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs).
The film trade platform aimed to facilitate global networking, trade, and collaboration within the media and entertainment sectors.

national_news.title: Nation Celebrates Constitution Day on November 26
bullets: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) was observed across India on November 26, marking the historic adoption of the Indian Constitution by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.
The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs facilitated an online reading of the Preamble via MyGov in 23 languages (22 Scheduled Languages and English).
As part of the outreach initiatives, the 'Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad' was organized across 786 districts in all 36 States and Union Territories to promote constitutional awareness among youth.

national_news.title: PM Chairs 55th PRAGATI Meeting, Reviews Infrastructure Projects Worth ₹78,000 Crore
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the 55th meeting of PRAGATI (Pro-Active Governance and Timely Implementation), an ICT-enabled multi-modal platform connecting Central and State governments.
The meeting reviewed five key infrastructure projects spanning road, power, coal, and railway sectors with a cumulative investment exceeding ₹78,000 crore.
PM reviewed the implementation of PM-SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) and proposed a '3C approach' (Classroom–Company–Career) for ITIs.

national_news.title: DARPG Conducts 42nd National Good Governance Webinar
bullets: The Department of Administrative Reforms & Public Grievances (DARPG) organized the 42nd National Good Governance Webinar focused on replicating successful administrative initiatives.
The webinar was themed 'Sustainability and Replication of the Initiatives Awarded under PMA', highlighting award-winning governance models from Ganjam and Koraput districts of Odisha.
The webinar series was launched in April 2022 to disseminate best practices from past winners of the Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration across all districts.

national_news.title: IndiaAI Mission Launches Indigenous Chariot-1 AI Foundation Models
bullets: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Secretary S Krishnan launched the indigenous Chariot-1 foundation models under the IndiaAI Mission in New Delhi.
Developed from scratch by Chariot Artificial Intelligence Pvt. Ltd., the suite includes an 11-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Model (LLM) and a Text-to-Speech (TTS) model.
The TTS model supports English and 10 Indian languages (including Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu), achieving over 97% verbalisation accuracy on the Async TTS Pronunciation Benchmark.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Observes Constitution Day at Kartavya Bhawan
bullets: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare commemorated Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) with a collective reading of the Preamble at Kartavya Bhawan, New Delhi.
Constitution Day is observed annually on 26th November to mark the adoption of the Constitution of India by the Constituent Assembly on November 26, 1949.
Senior officials alongside representatives from the National Health Authority (NHA), National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO), and National Medical Commission (NMC) participated in the event.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹2,014 Crore Doloo Greenfield Airport in Assam and Port Project in Tamil Nadu
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved a new Greenfield Airport at Doloo in Silchar, Cachar district, Assam, at an estimated cost of ₹2,014 crore.
To be developed by the Airports Authority of India (AAI), the airport features a 2,705m Code-4C compliant runway for A320 operations and an annual capacity of 1 million passengers.
The Cabinet also approved a ₹4,288-crore project to construct the Second Container Terminal at Kamarajar Port Limited in Tamil Nadu to enhance maritime freight handling.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights 'Kartavya' and Constitutional Values on Constitution Day
bullets: PM Narendra Modi authored a Constitution Day op-ed emphasizing 'Kartavya' (duty of citizens) to build a developed India by 2047.
Cited a recent World Bank report stating nearly 50 crore Indians have moved out of poverty due to targeted government schemes and digital platforms like UPI.
Highlighted that the 2019 abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A enabled the full implementation of the Indian Constitution in Jammu and Kashmir.

bihar_news.title: CCEA Approves Second Container Terminal at Kamarajar Port and Launch of Nayi Chetna 5.0
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the development of a 900-metre second container terminal at Kamarajar Port (formerly Ennore Port) in Tamil Nadu.
The project will be implemented under the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) model with a 40-year concession period, enhancing annual handling capacity by 2 million TEUs.
Union Ministers Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Annapurna Devi launched Nayi Chetna 5.0, a nationwide campaign focused on eliminating gender-based violence and promoting gender equality.

bihar_news.title: Delhi and Bihar Sign Reciprocal Agreement for 18 Year-Round Interstate Bus Routes
bullets: Delhi and Bihar have entered into a reciprocal transport agreement to operate year-round interstate bus services across 18 key routes, connecting Delhi to destinations such as Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, and Darbhanga.
The service aims to benefit nearly 20 lakh commuters by offering reliable travel options and mitigating festival rush and train ticket shortages.
Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC) is deploying 149 newly procured buses (75 non-AC and 74 AC), with an additional 150 buses planned under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets One Crore Litres of Daily Milk Production by 2030
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary announced a target to increase daily milk production from 48 lakh litres to 1 crore litres by 2030.
The initiative aims to strengthen the rural economy, promote women's financial independence, and expand the Sudha cooperative network.
Plans include promoting goat rearing to collect 1 lakh litres of goat milk daily, establishing veterinary clinics in every block, and supporting organic manure and compressed biogas projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Plans to Integrate AI Across Public Healthcare Delivery System
bullets: Bihar is integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its public healthcare delivery system to cover medical diagnostics, telemedicine, and emergency response.
The roadmap includes AI-enabled analysis of X-rays, CT scans, and MRIs to detect diseases like tuberculosis and cancer early.
The state is also deploying digital hospital bed management systems and piloting AI-enabled smart ambulances equipped with digital ECG and GPS tracking.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans 31 New Medical Colleges to Double MBBS Seats to 10,000 by 2030
bullets: Bihar plans to establish 31 new medical colleges (15 brownfield and 16 greenfield) over the next three years using a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The initiative aims to double the state's total MBBS seats from 5,000 to 10,000 by 2030 to serve its population of approximately 140 million.
The government also aims to establish at least one university in every district of Bihar within the next three to four years, having approved five new public and four private universities.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches First e-Cabinet System, Becomes 12th State
bullets: Bihar became the 12th Indian state to implement a paperless e-Cabinet system, launched on November 25, 2026, under Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.
The first paperless meeting approved 34 proposals, including an administrative sanction of ₹1,794.32 crore for Patna's water supply covering 75 wards.

The National Informatics Centre (NIC) developed the platform, and ministers were provided iPads costing approximately ₹2 crore, expected to be recovered through paper savings within six to seven months.

bihar_news.title: Centre Considers Special Shares for Merged PFC-REC Entity
bullets: The Ministry of Power is considering issuing special 'superior voting rights' shares ('One Share, Ten Votes') and redeemable preference shares to retain a 51.75% stake and majority control in the merged PFC-REC entity.
The proposed structure aims to maintain government company classification while managing the post-merger dilution of the Centre's shareholding from 55.99% to 42.02%.
Fresh government investments for the arrangement are estimated between ₹7,500 to ₹8,000 crore, subject to independent valuation.

bihar_news.title: Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari Win SKOCH Award
bullets: Bihar's Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari won the prestigious SKOCH Award for sustainable eco-tourism and governance innovation.
Rajgir Zoo Safari (19.12 hectares) and Nature Safari (550 hectares) feature modern technology integrations like QR-code ticketing, real-time GPS vehicle tracking, and CCTV surveillance.
Eco-tourism visitors in Bihar increased from 55.20 lakh in 2022-23 to 74.90 lakh in 2024-25, according to the Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department.

bihar_news.title: BPSC Issues New Notification for Assistant Education Development Officer Recruitment
bullets: The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) released Advertisement No. 16/2026 for 935 Assistant Education Development Officer (AEDO) posts under the Education Department.
This new notification supersedes the previously published Advertisement No. 87/2025.
Online applications are scheduled to be accepted from December 1 to December 31, 2026.

bihar_news.title: National Milk Day 2026 Celebrated in Patna; BAHS 2026 Report Released
bullets: National Milk Day 2026 was celebrated in Patna, Bihar, alongside the release of the Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (BAHS) 2026 report.

India's total milk production is estimated at 253.81 million tonnes for 2025-26, with Bihar's milk production increasing from 7.19 million metric tonnes in 2013-14 to 13.76 million metric tonnes in 2025-26.
The National Gopal Ratna Awards 2026 were conferred to recognize outstanding contributions to indigenous cattle and buffalo breed conservation and dairy development.
Key central schemes highlighted include the National Animal Disease Control Programme, Rashtriya Gokul Mission, and National Programme for Dairy Development.
